attachments.origin_landmark: ischial tuberosity (flat membranous tendon, separate from the biceps/semitendinosus conjoint tendon)
attachments.insertion_landmark: posteromedial tibial condyle (+ oblique popliteal ligament, popliteus fascia)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Largest PCSA of the hamstring group; broad flat proximal tendon distinguishes its architecture from semitendinosus's round cord-like tendon.
